name: find_client
description: Find the clinic's clients by part of their name

name: list_bookings
description: List bookings for a day, or one client's upcoming bookings

client.description: which client's bookings (an id from find_client)

name: move_client_series
description: Move a client's recurring appointments from one weekday and time to another, from a date onward. Returns a preview; nothing changes until the person confirms.

client.description: which client's appointments move (an id from find_client)

from_weekday.description: which weekday the appointments are on now

from_time.description: what time the appointments are at now (24-hour HH:MM)

to_weekday.description: which weekday the appointments should move to

to_time.description: what time the appointments should move to (24-hour HH:MM)

starting.description: when the move starts: a date, a week or a month

name: cancel_booking
description: Cancel one booking and tell the client. Returns a preview; nothing changes until the person confirms.

booking.description: which booking to cancel (an id from list_bookings)
